source: Parent enumerated all fourteen groups, read relevant primary headings/tables and compared annotation rectangles. #45/#71 share one overlay and are not two independent changes. #303 StrikeOut6812 lies over NOTE1; #126 rectangles only cover rolemapped at physical735 and742.

Current generic class API is covered by the new passing test.
limits: Selected corrections only; full namespace examples, all table header semantics and all layout defaults remain partial.
